title: Jerrel Beamon: Ohio Kid (2026) | Full Comedy Special
description:
Filmed live at Bricky's Comedy Club in Miamisburg, Ohio, Jerrel Beamon delivers a fearless hour of comedy covering everything from growing up in Dayton, relationships, true crime, AI girlfriends, dating, family, and the beautiful chaos of everyday life. Blending sharp observations with personal stories, Ohio Kid introduces one of the fastest-rising voices in stand-up.

If you laughed, hit LIKE, SUBSCRIBE, and leave your favorite joke in the comments. Sharing the special helps independent comedians continue making great comedy.
